text:
jamie: Quick heads up — my partner's due date moved earlier and it looks like my leave will overlap with the manager calibration week (May 12-14). Any guidance on handling my FY25 review while I'm out?
people-ops: Huge congrats! We can help. Do you have tentative leave dates so we can pick the right flow?
jamie: Probably May 10 -> Aug 10, so I would be away during calibration. My manager is leka.
leka: I can take the lead on calibration prep. @people-ops can we run an alternate flow so we can complete Jamie's review before leave? Prefer to lock comp/action items early.
people-ops: Yes — we offer two standard options for parental leave overlap: 1) Early manager-led review (we finalize ratings/comp before leave); 2) Defer review until return with interim goal agreement + pay protection per policy. Managers can request the early-review exception via the HR portal.
jamie: I prefer option 1 if possible. Want to avoid any ambiguity in the comp cycle. What do you need from us?
people-ops: We'll need: (a) completed leave intent form, (b) confirmation from the manager that calibration materials & notes will be finalized before your leave, and (c) a short manager summary in the review system indicating early-review exception. Link to form: https://redwood.internal/leave-intent 
people-ops: Also FYI — payroll/benefits cutoff to keep employer-paid family coverage active is Apr 28 this quarter. If you enroll after that date the employer subsidy may start one pay period later.
jamie: Good to know. I'll fill the form today. One more thing — I'm on the core infra oncall rotation. Can we arrange coverage?
leka: I can cover the first 6 weeks. Oliver, can you pick up weeks 7-12? @oliver
oliver: Yep I can do weeks 7-12. I don't have admin rights to add myself to the rota though. Can someone update the schedule?
people-ops: We don't edit oncall rotas directly, but we will ping eng-sre to update the rotation and mark you as 'parental leave protected' in the rota metadata. I'll open the ticket now.
people-ops: Quick checklist for jamie so nothing falls through: - Fill leave intent form - Attach expected due date doc (if available) - Confirm early-review request with manager - Confirm oncall coverage plan in a shared doc - Set an OOO note with contact for urgent issues
jamie: Thank you. One more Q — planning a gradual return. Is flexible return allowed (e.g., 3 remote days / 2 onsite for first 4 weeks)?
people-ops: Yes — flexible/part-time return schedules are supported. Manager approval required and we capture it on the leave plan. We'll add a 'return schedule' section to your file (e.g., 3/2 hybrid for 4 weeks).
leka: I'll approve that schedule. Can we also get a 'handoff shortlist' for post-return ramp? A 1-pager of key context would help.
jamie: I'll prepare a 1-pager and a runbook PR before leave.
people-ops-bot: (automated) Leave intent form submitted by jamie at 1795561111
people-ops: Got it — we received the form and initiated the early-review flow. We'll coordinate with comp to surface anything needed before calibration. Expect a confirmation email by EOD.
jamie: Amazing, thank you all :heart:
